list.name: setup
list.label: Book
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT setup FROM carry_delta_time ORDER BY setup

list.name: instrument
list.label: Instrument
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT instrument FROM carry_delta_time WHERE setup = '$setup' ORDER BY instrument

panels.title: Net delta by instrument (USD)
panels.description: Perp + spot. This is the number that says whether the book is hedged; neither leg alone does. Sustained non-zero means directional exposure that is not being paid for.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", instrument AS metric, (data->>'delta_usd')::float8 AS value FROM carry_delta_time WHERE setup = '$setup' AND instrument IN ($instrument) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Carry income, annualised (USD)
panels.description: abs(perp notional) x annualised funding on the short leg. The spot leg pays nothing, which is the point of this structure - so this is gross carry before fees and borrow.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", instrument AS metric, (data->>'carry_ann_usd')::float8 AS value FROM carry_delta_time WHERE setup = '$setup' AND instrument IN ($instrument) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Venue collateral
panels.description: Cross-venue carries do NOT net margin: Hyperliquid collateral cannot support the Binance leg or the reverse. A sharp move can margin-call one venue while the offsetting profit is stranded on the other, so each venue's headroom is watched separately.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", exchange || ' free' AS metric, (data->>'free')::float8 AS value FROM carry_venue_time WHERE setup = '$setup' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Binance uniMMR
panels.description: Portfolio Margin health. Healthy above ~1.2; liquidation begins around 1.05. Only meaningful for the Binance leg - Hyperliquid margin is tracked as free collateral instead.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", 'uniMMR' AS metric, (data->>'uni_mmr')::float8 AS value FROM carry_venue_time WHERE setup = '$setup' AND exchange = 'binance' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: $instrument
panels.description: This row is REPEATED per instrument. Adding an instrument to CARRY_INSTRUMENTS makes it appear here with no dashboard edit - which is the whole reason the schema carries instrument as a column rather than a key inside a JSON blob.

panels.title: $instrument legs (USD)
panels.description: Perp and spot notional side by side, with net delta. A healthy carry shows the two legs mirrored and delta flat near zero.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", 'perp' AS metric, (data->>'perp_usd')::float8 AS value FROM carry_delta_time WHERE setup = '$setup' AND instrument = '$instrument' AND $__timeFilter(time) UNION ALL SELECT time, 'spot', (data->>'spot_usd')::float8 FROM carry_delta_time WHERE setup = '$setup' AND instrument = '$instrument' AND $__timeFilter(time) UNION ALL SELECT time, 'delta', (data->>'delta_usd')::float8 FROM carry_delta_time WHERE setup = '$setup' AND instrument = '$instrument' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: $instrument delta vs target
panels.description: Actual net delta against the configured target. Persistent divergence means the strategy is not reaching or holding its target - the failure mode that looks like nothing happening.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", 'perp notional' AS metric, (data->>'perp_usd')::float8 AS value FROM carry_delta_time WHERE setup = '$setup' AND instrument = '$instrument' AND $__timeFilter(time) UNION ALL SELECT time, 'target', (data->>'target_usd')::float8 FROM carry_delta_time WHERE setup = '$setup' AND instrument = '$instrument' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: $instrument funding (annualised %) and basis (bps)
panels.description: Funding is what the carry earns. Basis is HL mark vs Binance spot - a widening basis means the two legs are marked against drifting references, so a flat delta is less flat than it looks.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", 'funding ann %' AS metric, (data->>'funding_rate_ann')::float8 * 100 AS value FROM carry_leg_time WHERE setup = '$setup' AND instrument = '$instrument' AND leg = 'perp' AND $__timeFilter(time) UNION ALL SELECT time, 'basis bps', (data->>'basis_bps')::float8 FROM carry_delta_time WHERE setup = '$setup' AND instrument = '$instrument' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1
